title: Bridging Local Inductive Bias and Long-Range Dependencies with Pixel-Mamba for End-to-end Whole Slide Image Analysis
text: Introduces Pixel-Mamba, an end-to-end architecture for gigapixel whole slide image analysis that combines the Mamba state-space model with progressive token expansion to capture both local and global information, matching or surpassing foundation models pretrained on millions of WSIs without pathology-specific pretraining.
